name: ShenzhenJingQuanHua Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: ShenzhenJingQuanHua Electronics Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells electronic components, power supplies, and specialized transformers in China and internationally. The company provides inverters, high-frequency inductors, special reactors, three-phase transformers, isolation transformers, metering transformers, common-mode inductors, and surface-mount transformers; and magnetic device products, such as high-frequency transformers, inductors, filters, current transformers, potted inductors, PFC inductors, and other series, as well as power supply products, such as intelligent power supplies, gallium nitride power supplies, power adapters, bare-board power supplies, LED power supplies,…
